shared_elements: animals in relief on stone surfaces
quadruped animal in profile with head and limbs
long-snouted / reptilian creature seen from above or in profile
shallow low-relief carving with outlined bodies and no interior infill
multiple animals arranged together on one surface
justification: Both surfaces show several animals rendered as shallow low-relief silhouettes with plain, uninfilled bodies, including sprawling long-bodied reptile-like creatures with splayed limbs seen from above, which is a reasonably specific shared convention. However, A is a structured composition on a rectangular pillar with a horizontal banded register, a large prowling quadruped in profile above a smaller crouching animal, plus bird heads and a plant-like frond, whereas B is an unordered scatter of creatures over irregular boulders with no register, no band and no plant or bird motifs, so the relationships and arrangement do not correspond.
